connectorUiConfig.title: WhoisFreaks Threat & NRD Feeds (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Ingest WhoisFreaks threat feeds and newly registered domain data into Microsoft Sentinel. Select only feeds included in your WhoisFreaks subscription. Every selected feed first reads its own last_update date from the v3.4 status response, then downloads the dated CSV using offset/limit paging. Threat fields retain their API names; WHOIS NRD retains the API field names; no-WHOIS NRD is stored in its own table with one domain_name payload column.

sampleQueries.query:
WhoisFreaksThreat_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20

WhoisFreaksNRD_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20

WhoisFreaksNRDNoWhois_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20

sampleQueries.description: NRD domains also in threat feeds
sampleQueries.query:
union (WhoisFreaksNRD_CL | project domain_name), (WhoisFreaksNRDNoWhois_CL | project domain_name)
| join kind=inner (WhoisFreaksThreat_CL | distinct domain) on $left.domain_name == $right.domain

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

WhoisFreaks commercial threat intelligence (malware, phishing, spam) and newly registered domain (NRD) ingestion for Microsoft Sentinel via the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF).

Endpoints

  • Status: https://files.whoisfreaks.com/v3.4/status (read first for NRD feeds)
  • Threat: https://files.whoisfreaks.com/v3.4/stream/threat-feed/{malware|phishing|spam}
  • NRD: https://files.whoisfreaks.com/v3.3/stream/domainer/{gtld|cctld}
  • Threat authentication: X-API-KEY header
  • NRD authentication: X-API-KEY header (same as threat feeds)

Data Connectors: 1
